figures.finding: The employer withholds the wages and salary tax when it pays and remits it to the Bureau within 30 days; a Palauan citizen earning $15,000 or less gets the whole tax refunded, and one earning $15,000 to $30,000 gets back the 6% on the first $8,000 ($480).

otherRefund.tuitionOrDonations: up to 10% of wages and salary tax paid

figures.applies: From tax year 2023 (PGST reform); citizens only for the special refunds.

sources.said: Deduct and withhold the tax when wages or salaries are paid. Pay the withheld tax to the Bureau of Revenue & Taxation within 30 days of disbursement.

Employees earning $15,000 or less in wages and salary during a tax year will receive a refund of the entire wages and salary tax withheld and paid. Employees earning between $15,000 and $30,000 will receive a refund of wages and salary tax (6%) withheld from the first $8,000 in wages and salary, totaling $480.
Employees working for employers outside Palau, or without a local agent, must file returns and pay taxes directly as if their employer were based in Palau.

figures.finding: Palau taxes an employee's wages and salary at 6% on the first $8,000, 10% from $8,000 to $40,000 and 12% above $40,000, with no personal allowance; a business not registered for PGST pays 4% Gross Revenue Tax on quarterly gross revenue, and a PGST-registered business pays 12% Business Profits Tax on net income.
figures.applies: Wages and salary for work in Palau; settled 2026-11-01 from the BRT page: the bands are 6% to $8,000, 10% to $40,000 and 12% above (the 2021 proposals of $50,000 reported by the press were not what is in force).

sources.said: Employees are taxed on their wages and salaries at the following rates: 6% on the first $8,000 of wages and salary earned 10% on wages and salary earned over $8,000 up to $40,000 12% on wages and salary earned over $40,000
Tax Rate: Subject to a 4% Gross Revenue Tax on quarterly gross revenue.
It is calculated at 12% tax on net income (gross revenue less allowable deductions), the same rate as the highest rate of tax on wages and salary.

figures.finding: A non-resident earning royalties or technical fees (fees for managerial, administrative, technical, professional or consultancy services) from Palau bears a final-in-form 10% withholding on the gross, with no deductions; a non-resident employed in Palau pays the wages and salary tax.

value.remit: last day of the month after payment

figures.applies: Whether a performer's or director's fee is a "technical fee" (professional services) is not stated by BRT; the game reads such a fee as professional services.

sources.said: Technical fee – Fees for managerial, administrative, technical, professional, or consultancy services, including supply of personnel. Does not include employee wages.
Tax Rates Insurance premiums – 5% Other income (e.g., interest, royalties, technical fees) – 10%
Tax is imposed on the gross income earned by the non‑resident, with no deductions for expenses or losses. The tax is collected via withholding at the time of payment.

figures.finding: Royalties paid to a non-resident for the use of copyrights bear the 10% non-resident withholding; no special treatment of a resident author's royalties is given.

sources.said: Royalty – Payments, whether lump sum or periodic, for: Use of intellectual property (copyrights, patents, trademarks, designs, formulas, processes).

figures.finding: PGST is 10%; a supplier must register when average taxable supplies over four years exceed $300,000.

value.thresholdBasis: average of the last 4 years' taxable supplies

sources.said: It is a broad-based tax of 10%, applied to most goods and services and other items sold or consumed in Palau.
If you have average taxable supplies of more than $300,000, you must register for PGST, unless you meet one of the exemption categories.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; the employer gives each employee the W-2 statement by 2 February 2026 for 2025.
